title: 45,000㎡ of Murals, Not One Signed — Dunhuang Mogao Caves | China Travel Expert
description:
45,000 square meters of murals, painted across a thousand years — and not one is signed. Would you?

Dunhuang's Mogao Caves (莫高窟) hold 735 caves carved into a desert cliff, 492 of them filled with murals and painted sculptures. The first was dug in 366 CE, and painting continued through roughly ten dynasties. The artists were generations of anonymous craftsmen (画工) whose names were never recorded — a thousand years of masterpieces, all unsigned.

🧭 Expert Tip: Mogao caps daily visitors and the best "special caves" sell out — reserve your ticket online well before you travel, not at the gate.
